facts.what: Licensed contractors under the BCA licensing regime
facts.value: 2,265 licences when the law came into force: 924 building, 832 demolition, 509 excavation; later reports say over 1,300 building licences
facts.source: Building and Construction Authority, reported by MaltaToday; later figure reported by Ground News (date not shown)

facts.what: Average days to collect business debts (DSO)
facts.value: 80.41 days in 2023, against a European B2B average of 56 days
